title: STT GDC
bottom_line: STT GDC Indonesia (PT STT GDC Indonesia) is a joint venture with Triputra and Temasek, and STT GDC controls it. Since 31 Aug 2026, STT GDC itself is owned 75% by KKR and 25% by Singtel, after a S$6.6 bn buyout of ST Telemedia, but Temasek has not left: it is still a direct JV partner and owns about 51.69% of Singtel. The 374 MW campus in GIIC is powered only by PLN, through PLN's shared 120 MVA "Data Center" substation (Amazon, Microsoft, Komdigi and Telkom use it too) and STT's own on-campus 150 kV substation; no contracted MVA has been published, and the renewable plan with PLN has no stated form or size. Total Bangun Persada builds it on its "Iris" contracts, and STT was that contractor's biggest customer in 2025 (Rp801.7 bn, 20.55% of revenue); the land was bought from Sinar Mas's Puradelta (Rp210.8 bn in 2025), and the build is funded by an IDR 8.8 tn loan from OCBC, HSBC and BNI with a green tranche.

entities.name: STT GDC Indonesia
entities.what: Indonesian company of the STT GDC joint venture with Triputra and Temasek. It builds and runs the STT Jakarta campus in GIIC, Kota Deltamas: nine buildings listed at 374 MW IT ('more than 360MW'), 42 MW live (Jakarta 1 and 2) in Oct 2026.

entities.name: STT GDC Indonesia JVCo
entities.legal_name: STT GDC Indonesia JVCo Pte. Ltd.
entities.what: Singapore holding company of the Indonesian joint venture. STT GDC's Indonesia page names its board: Liu Chee Ming (chair), Zulkifli Baharudin, Arif Rachmat (Triputra), Ing Hie Kwik (Temasek) and Bruno Lopez. The shareholding split is not published.

entities.name: STT GDC (STTGDC)
entities.what: Singapore data-centre group set up by ST Telemedia in 2014: 2.3-2.7 GW of capacity across 12 markets (STT's own pages differ), 780 MW operating by Sep 2026. Owned 75% by KKR and 25% by Singtel since 31 Aug 2026.

entities.name: ST Telemedia
entities.what: Temasek-owned investor in communications, data centres and infrastructure technology. It founded STT GDC and sold its remaining ~81.7% (held through STT Communications Ltd.) to KKR and Singtel for S$6.6 bn, completed 31 Aug 2026.

entities.name: Temasek
entities.what: Singapore state investment company. It wholly owns the ST Telemedia group, holds about 51.69% of Singtel, and is itself a named partner in the Indonesian JV.

entities.name: KKR
entities.what: Global investment firm. Through KKR Opal Topco LP it holds 75% of STT GDC since 31 Aug 2026, after a 2024 preference-share investment; it also owns 20% of Singtel's Nxera.

entities.name: KKR Asia Pacific Infrastructure Investors II
entities.what: KKR fund that made KKR's June 2024 investment in STT GDC (redeemable preference shares with warrants).

entities.name: Singtel
entities.what: Singapore telecom group, about 51.69% held by Temasek. Holds 25% of STT GDC through Singtel Interactive Pte. Ltd. since 31 Aug 2026 and runs its own data-centre arm, Nxera.

entities.name: Nxera
entities.what: Singtel's regional data-centre arm; KKR bought 20% of it in Sep 2023. Its CEO Bill Chang backed Telkom's NeutraDC Nxera Batam project in 2024.

entities.name: NeutraDC Nxera Batam
entities.what: Telkom-group data-centre company building an AI data centre in the Kabil industrial estate, Batam (piling ceremony 13 Jun 2024). Covered by the NeutraDC web.

entities.name: Triputra Group
entities.what: Indonesian conglomerate founded in 1998 by former Astra CEO T.P. Rachmat (agribusiness, manufacturing, energy, trading and services, education). Local partner in the STT GDC Indonesia JV since May 2021.

entities.name: VIRTUS Data Centres
entities.what: STT GDC's UK data-centre business, majority-owned by STT GDC (Macquarie's MEIF7 holds a significant minority). JV director Zulkifli Baharudin sits on the Virtus HoldCo board.

entities.name: STT Jakarta 1
entities.what: First building, Block EA-1, GIIC: up to 18 MW IT (19.5 MW in 2022-23 releases), 18,474 m2 gross floor area. Operating since June 2023. Uptime Tier III design, LEED Gold, design PUE 1.41, fed by two 20 kV utility supplies.

entities.name: STT Jakarta 2
entities.what: 24 MW IT, 21,291 m2 gross floor area. Ground broken Sep 2024, topped out Apr 2025, operating since 10 Jun 2026. Liquid-cooling ready, design PUE under 1.30, fed by the campus 150 kV substation.

entities.name: STT Jakarta 3
entities.what: Up to 24 MW IT, 16,876 m2 gross floor area. Ground broken Apr 2025, topped out 10 Jun 2026, ready for service Q1 2027 per its factsheet. Built with STT's first Indonesian green-loan tranche; PUE target 1.30.

entities.name: STT Jakarta 4
entities.what: Listed at 48 MW IT and 'Under Development' on STT's page; an Apr 2025 report gave 32 MW. No dates published.

entities.name: STT Jakarta 5
entities.what: 40 MW IT, 18,000 m2 gross floor area. Ground broken 10 Jun 2026, ready for service Q4 2027. Liquid-cooling ready, design PUE under 1.38.

entities.name: STT Jakarta 6
entities.what: 40 MW IT, 18,000 m2 gross floor area. Ground broken 10 Jun 2026, ready for service Q4 2027. Twin of Jakarta 5.

entities.name: STT Jakarta 7
entities.what: 60 MW IT, listed as 'Under Development' on STT's page; no dates.

entities.name: STT Jakarta 8
entities.what: 60 MW IT, listed as 'Under Development' on STT's page; no dates.

entities.name: STT Jakarta 9
entities.what: 60 MW IT, listed as 'Under Development' on STT's page; no dates.

entities.name: PLN
entities.what: State electricity company. It feeds the campus through its GIIC 'Data Center' substation and STT's own 150 kV substation, and is STT's partner on a renewable-energy plan.

entities.name: PLN GI 150 kV Data Center (GIIC)
entities.what: PLN substation for GIIC data centres: 2 x 60 MVA (120 MVA) with 150 kV lines to Deltamas, KIIC II/Margakarya and THK, more than Rp312 bn, finished Nov 2024. PLN names Amazon, Microsoft, Komdigi, Telkom and STT as users.

entities.name: STT Jakarta campus 150 kV substation
entities.what: High-voltage substation on the STT campus that feeds Jakarta 2, 3, 5 and 6 at 20 kV (N+1). STT calls it the first energised for a data-centre campus in Indonesia, with independent links to several PLN substations. Owner, MVA and builder not published.

entities.name: Elsewedy Electric Indonesia
entities.what: Indonesian transformer maker of Egypt's Elsewedy Electric group; PLN's contractor for the GI 150 kV 'KTT Data Center' in GIIC.

entities.name: Puradelta Lestari (Kota Deltamas / GIIC)
entities.what: IDX: DMAS. Developer of Kota Deltamas and the GIIC industrial estate. Its ~300 ha data-centre zone (since 2021) had 15 DC tenants at end-2025, with 993 MVA of PLN 'premium' supply, fibre ducts for up to 12 ISPs and recycled water for DC cooling.

entities.name: Sinarmas Land
entities.what: Sinar Mas group property company; ultimate parent of Puradelta Lestari through PT Sumber Arusmulia (57.28%).

entities.name: Sojitz
entities.what: Japanese trading house; holds 25.00% of Puradelta Lestari.

entities.name: Total Bangun Persada
entities.what: IDX: TOTL. Building contractor. PT STT GDC Indonesia was its largest customer in 2025 (20.55% of revenue), through contracts named 'Iris 2', 'Iris 3' and 'IRIS 5 & 6'.

entities.name: Xtralis (VESDA)
entities.what: Maker of VESDA aspirating smoke detectors; VESDA appears in the factsheets of Jakarta 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 (installer not named).

entities.name: Uptime Institute
entities.what: Data-centre rating body; certified the design documents of Jakarta 1 (Phase 1) at Tier III.

entities.name: USGBC (LEED)
entities.what: US Green Building Council, which runs LEED; Jakarta 1 is LEED Gold and the later buildings target LEED Gold.

entities.name: OCBC (OCBC Ltd and OCBC NISP)
entities.legal_name: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation Limited / PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk
entities.what: Lead bank on STT GDC Indonesia's IDR 8.8 tn facility (coordinating bank, sole green coordinator, facility agent) and a lead arranger of the S$5 bn buyout loan.

entities.name: HSBC Indonesia
entities.what: Arranger of STT GDC Indonesia's IDR 8.8 tn facility (Jun 2026).

entities.name: BNI
entities.what: State-owned bank (IDX: BBNI); arranger of STT GDC Indonesia's IDR 8.8 tn facility (Jun 2026).

entities.name: DBS
entities.what: Lead arranger and bookrunner of the S$5 bn sustainability-linked loan for the KKR-Singtel buyout. JV chairman Liu Chee Ming sits on the board of its Hong Kong bank.

entities.name: UOB
entities.what: Lead arranger and bookrunner of the S$5 bn sustainability-linked loan for the KKR-Singtel buyout (Aug 2026).

entities.name: Ministry of Investment (BKPM)
entities.what: Indonesia's investment ministry and investment board; its SE Asia investment-promotion director spoke for the government at the 10 Jun 2026 expansion ceremony.

entities.name: APJII (IIX)
entities.what: Indonesian ISP association (founded 1996) that runs the Indonesia Internet Exchange (IIX); opened an IIX node in Jakarta 1.

entities.name: ATMI Cikarang
entities.what: Vocational institute in Cikarang that hosts STT GDC's Data Centre Laboratory Learning Centre (MoU 10 Jun 2026).

entities.name: EPI
entities.what: Data-centre training firm delivering the Data Centre Fundamentals Certificate (DCFC) course in STT GDC Indonesia's talent programme.

entities.name: NVIDIA
entities.what: GPU maker. STT GDC is an NVIDIA colocation partner and says its Jakarta halls are engineered for NVIDIA Vera Rubin platforms.

entities.name: Moratelindo
entities.what: Telecom infrastructure and network provider (IDX: MORA); first carrier to sign for a PoP in Jakarta 1 (Dec 2022).

entities.name: Lightstorm
entities.what: Carrier-neutral network platform; PoP MoU (Jun 2023) and listed carrier at Jakarta 1.

entities.name: Weave
entities.what: Connectivity infrastructure company; PoP MoU at Jakarta 1 (Jun 2023).

entities.name: PGAS Telekomunikasi Nusantara
entities.what: Domestic and international fibre network provider; PoP MoU at Jakarta 1 (Jun 2023).

entities.name: Sinergy Networks
entities.legal_name: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk
entities.what: Telecom services company (IDX: INET); PoP MoU at Jakarta 1 (Jun 2023). Its unit SIDI also runs a small data centre (power-map record sidi-jkt01-cyber-1).

entities.name: Berca Hardayaperkasa
entities.what: ICT company; MoU (Jun 2023) to explore managed services delivered from Jakarta 1.

entities.name: PLN Icon Plus
entities.what: Network provider listed as 'Iconplus' on STT's carrier page for Jakarta 1 (internet access, IP transit, IX, layer 1-3).

entities.name: Fiber Media Indonesia
entities.what: Dark-fibre provider listed on STT's carrier page for Jakarta 1.

entities.name: Xenith IG
entities.what: Dark-fibre provider listed on STT's carrier page for Jakarta 1.

entities.name: SMT
entities.what: Listed by STT as the dark-fibre provider 'within Greenland International Industrial Centre' for Jakarta 1; full name not given.

entities.name: Bruno Lopez
entities.what: President and Group CEO of STT GDC since 2014; listed on the Indonesia JV board; earlier CEO and executive director of Keppel Data Centres.

entities.name: Hendrikus Hendra Gozali
entities.what: Country Head, Indonesia, heading PT STT GDC Indonesia since 1 Aug 2022; earlier Indonesia country GM at Johnson Controls, with roles at Honeywell, Schindler and Trane.

entities.name: Lionel Yeo
entities.what: CEO, Southeast Asia, STT GDC (quoted on the Indonesia business from Dec 2022 to Jun 2026).

entities.name: Nelson Lim
entities.what: Group CFO of STT GDC; spoke for the Jun 2026 Indonesia financing and the Jan 2024 S$450m perpetual issue.

entities.name: Liu Chee Ming
entities.what: Non-executive chairman of STT GDC Indonesia JVCo; managing director of Platinum Holdings (founded 1996); independent director of DBS Bank (Hong Kong) since 2018 and non-executive director of MGM China since 2021.

entities.name: Zulkifli Baharudin
entities.what: Director of STT GDC Indonesia JVCo; executive chairman of Indo-Trans Corporation since 2011; non-executive director of Virtus HoldCo since 2017.

entities.name: Arif Rachmat
entities.what: Director of STT GDC Indonesia JVCo and commissioner of Triputra (PT Triputra Investindo Arya); spoke for Triputra as its director when the JV was announced in 2021. Vice chairman of KADIN, per STT's page.

entities.name: Ing Hie Kwik
entities.what: Director of STT GDC Indonesia JVCo; Operating Partner at Temasek since 2018; founded Sternbridge Partners (2015-2018); earlier Indonesia head of Affinity Equity Partners (2009-2014) and president director of Morgan Stanley Indonesia (2007-2009).

entities.name: T.P. Rachmat
entities.what: Theodore Permadi Rachmat, former CEO of Astra; founded Triputra (PT Triputra Investindo Arya) in 1998.

entities.name: Stephen Miller
entities.what: President and Group CEO of ST Telemedia (2024-2026 releases).

entities.name: David Luboff
entities.what: Co-head of KKR Asia Pacific and head of Asia Pacific infrastructure; KKR's spokesman on both STT GDC deals.

entities.name: Arthur Lang
entities.what: Group CFO of Singtel; Singtel's spokesman on both STT GDC deals.

entities.name: Keppel Data Centres
entities.what: Keppel group's data-centre business; Bruno Lopez was its CEO and executive director before founding STT GDC.

entities.name: Platinum Holdings
entities.what: Company Liu Chee Ming set up in March 1996 and still runs as managing director.

entities.name: Indo-Trans Corporation
entities.what: Logistics and supply-chain company across Indo-China; Zulkifli Baharudin is executive chairman.

entities.name: Sternbridge Partners
entities.what: Investment firm Ing Hie Kwik founded and ran from 2015 to 2018; it took a significant minority stake in DCI Indonesia.

entities.name: DCI Indonesia
entities.what: Listed Indonesian data-centre operator (IDX: DCII); has its own web in this set.
